concept: ECS on Fargate: scheduled container runs via EventBridge
tests: Choosing the least labor-intensive way to run a short container task on a schedule without servers or clusters.
expected: ECS task on Fargate + an EventBridge scheduled rule (cron) — no instances at all. Triggers: "containerized", "nightly", "~20 minutes", "do not want to manage servers or clusters".
why_not: ECS on EC2, AWS Batch on a managed EC2 compute environment, EKS with a self-managed node group — all require managing instances/nodes.
